H01.description: Header comment update describing the widened hidden-token rules.

H02.description: Header comment update describing quote-state and heredoc operator-line scanning.

H03.description: Header comment: grade.json field list and grader version changelog.

H04.description: With no SIGTERM handler, a grader killed by the runner's deadline skips the finally block, so the SCRATCH directory is left behind.

H05.description: HIDDEN_TOKEN only matches lowercase adjacency, so Bash probes like Hidden/x, hiddenTests/, HiddenTests/, '*hidden*' globs and `cd hidden` are not flagged as contamination.

H06.description: The HEREDOC regex with re.S and a lazy (?:.*?\n)*? body backtracks catastrophically on a << that is not a heredoc ($((1<<n)), <<<) and drops the operator-line remainder. The same hunk also fixes the in_quotes parity count and the empty-quote glued-token case in after_closing_quote.

H07.description: strip_heredocs replaces the whole operator line after <<WORD, so a redirect, pipe or argument such as `cat <<'EOF' > /root/x` is never path-scanned.

H08.description: The Bash hidden check uses only HIDDEN_TOKEN, so glob and filesystem-probe shapes of hidden go undetected.

H09.description: Adds heredoc_interpreters telemetry, recording the accepted gap that interpreter heredoc bodies are not path-scanned.

H10.description: A globbed one-component word (/roo*, /ro?t) is read as a slash-command token and skipped, so a glob that reaches /root evades the outside_path check.

H11.description: Every word starting with /. is skipped as a dot-directory, so /./root/x and /../root/x evade the outside_path check.

H12.description: in_quotes uses a quote parity count, so a sensitive word that is the whole quoted argument (cd "/root") is skipped, and an apostrophe elsewhere in the command flips the result.

H13.description: Adds the heredoc_interpreters field to grade.json.

H14.description: Resets the heredoc_interpreters counter for each grade.

H15.description: Records the heredoc_interpreters count in grade.json.

H16.description: Header doc for the took-effect timeout.

H17.description: Header doc for the grade timeout.

H18.description: Header doc for the MANIFEST watchdog fields.

H19.description: Header doc for the new environment variables.

H20.description: Adds the timeout configuration variables used by the deadline fix.

H21.description: Validates the timeout variables and builds the timeout wrappers for the deadline fix.

H22.description: Passes the timeouts into the MANIFEST jq call.

H23.description: Records the timeouts in MANIFEST watchdog.

H24.description: Comment adds the timeout value of PR_TE.

H25.description: took-effect.sh runs with no deadline, so a hang stalls the batch indefinitely, and any non-zero exit pauses the arm.

H26.description: The grader runs with no post-run deadline, so a hung grade blocks the trial and the batch forever.

H28.description: Stub header doc for the hang option.

H29.description: Adds a hang option to the grade stub.

H30.description: Unsets the new environment variables in test setup.

I01.description: The repo_name scan checks the whole Bash value, heredoc bodies included, so a reviewer quoting the PR's own '0xHoneyJar/loa' text in a heredoc is marked contaminated (KF-046 class 7).

I03.description: Fixes the oracle detector and the class-7 exemption, both added after head.

I04.description: Edge fixes to the r1a oracle-detector code added after head.

I05.description: Fixes the repo-name exemption, detector bounds and corpus_sha256, all introduced after head.

I06.description: Later eval_only report feature; not head behaviour.

I07.description: Later eval_only/oracle_open handling; not head behaviour.

I08.description: Grader 1.3.0 oracle detector error-result handling, added after head.
